about: Entry 34: club discovery and gaming questions. Clubs may be named only if one of our official csulb.edu pages lists them; every club question gets a BeachSync search button (beachsyncTerm) built by our code from a short keyword. BeachSync itself is never fetched. Gaming uses the ASI Games Area page. Run with: TESTS_FILE=tests/club-and-gaming-questions.json RESULTS_FILE=docs/test-results-clubs.md npm run test:questions

tests.question: I'm Cambodian, how can I get involved with my culture on campus?
tests.expected_behavior: Answer naming the Cambodian Student Society (from the official Cambodian Graduation Celebration page, Entry 35) and the Asian, Pacific Islander, and Desi Resource Center, cited. No other Cambodian club named (none is on an official page). No 'contact details were removed' note, and no Engineering or Liberal Arts club page cited. A BeachSync search for a Cambodian keyword.
tests.expected_fact: The Cambodian Student Society invites any Cambodian identifying students to join them

tests.question: I'm a CS student, what clubs can help me gain experience?
tests.expected_behavior: Names at least one club from the Engineering Student Clubs & Organizations page (for example ACM or the Video Game Development Club), cited. A BeachSync search.

tests.question: is there a chess club
tests.expected_behavior: No source lists a chess club: says our CSULB pages don't list one (or falls back), never invents one. A BeachSync search for chess.

tests.question: clubs for nursing students
tests.expected_behavior: Names the nursing student association from the Health & Human Services Student Organizations page, cited. A BeachSync search for nursing.

tests.question: is there an underwater basket weaving club
tests.expected_behavior: No such club in our sources: says so (or falls back), never invents one. A BeachSync search.

tests.question: where can i play video games on campus
tests.expected_behavior: Answer from the ASI Games Area page: the Games Center is closed for the FUTURE U Project and the Esports Lounge moved to Peterson Hall 1 (PH1) Room-218. Or, if it falls back, Who can help = ASI. Never a Tuition and Fees button.
tests.expected_fact: Esports Lounge will be relocated to Peterson Hall 1 (PH1) Room-218
